verdicts.criticalReason: A terminal status field (COMPLETED) is being set via a plain read-then-save instead of a guarded conditional update. In DossierBuilderService.java, it calls dossierReportRepository.updateStatus('PENDING', 'COMPLETED') but immediately follows it with report.setStatus('COMPLETED'); dossierReportRepository.save(report), which overwrites the guarded update with a plain save of the terminal status field. This violates the strict requirement to never use a plain read-then-save for terminal states.
